cases.job_admission_label: WHOLE JOB NOT ADMITTED — memory gate

actual_summary.scope: Passive complete saved-file joins and literal word-dictionary display decoding; no scientific Source execution/replay. Aggregate observation counts include any explicitly NONADMITTED failed attempts; separate admitted counts follow.

assessment: Only one executable statement changed: the removal observer reads the immutable parent domains instead of retaining another set copy. Independent Source review establishes equal removal-witness values for corresponding transitions under the pinned runtime. It does not establish identical timed prefixes, a universal peak-memory bound or a speedup.

All three workers returned complete packets and all six point calls completed two full domain/inverse/scheduler audits. Two whole jobs qualified: equality and the missing-premise control. Their point calls made 65 placements and 8 audits. Across every packet, including the rejected job, 99 placements and 12 audits were observed. The admitted and nonadmitted counts are kept separate.

The first positive child now returns COMPLETE, but its parent conservative peak is 1,078,247,424 bytes and whole peak is 1,109,278,720 bytes, both above 1 GiB. That job and its raw S0 checker-accepted 14-line candidate remain nonadmitted. The equality job passes at 882,720,768 bytes and the negative at 880,361,472 bytes, including post-output peaks.

The historical D8 equality job failed at 1,153,777,664 whole bytes; the new D9 job passes at 882,720,768. The negative remains admitted but its observed whole peak increased from 860,045,312 to 880,361,472. These are one development run per case/version with different timed search prefixes and possible allocation/GC effects. They are not statistical speedup evidence or measured phase-memory attribution.

In each admitted case, certified P10 markings remove 12 incidences in the initial exhaustive Graph audit. The 48 independent word-reference controls also returned in both admitted cases. All exclusions still concern shallow first-row incompatibilities, not learned multiscale proof abstractions.

Six searches are qualified and six cluster arms skipped in the admitted jobs; all three raw packets contain nine searches and nine skips. Grounded cluster registry admission remained Native-unknown, so there was no recipient cluster reuse or trained RL. Both point methods and the conventional equality search remain budget-unknown.

The remaining memory problem needs a new isolated experiment. Owned cutoff exceptions can retain recursive frames through tracebacks; the active recursion itself also owns graph copies. Source ownership can identify these candidates, but no phase-memory instrumentation was collected and no allocation has been established as the measured dominant cause.

The research goal remains practical boundary tiling, hierarchical lemma/receptor inventory, genuine learned proposals, and automated arithmetic/Hilbert-geometry proof discovery with conventional benchmarks. A physical universal Wang system and Turtle/Penrose plane constructions remain separate unfinished requirements.
